```{r load_data}
paired_se <- readRDS(file.path("data", "TCGA-PRAD_paired_se.rds"))

counts   <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(paired_se, "counts")          # genes x samples
metadata <- as.data.frame(SummarizedExperiment::colData(paired_se))   # one row per sample
genes    <- as.data.frame(SummarizedExperiment::rowData(paired_se))   # gene_id, gene_name, gene_type
```
